svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
The private key does not match
Application server (TLS-APP01) · RHEL 9 Bash terminal · learner@10.90.0.10
RHEL 9 — learner@tls-app01
COMMAND / FILE CONTENT TO ENTER — PRESERVE CASE
set -o pipefail
openssl x509 -in ~/tls-work/app-v3.crt -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER | openssl
dgst -sha256
sudo openssl pkey -in /etc/pki/tls/private/app-v3.key -pubout -outform DER | openssl dgst -sha256
sudo nginx -t
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
SIMULATED FAILURE CLUE — Different public-key fingerprints indicate a wrong pair. NGINX may
report key values mismatch.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. Use the troubleshooting simulation below to select this scenario and read its simulated evidence.
2. On your own VM, run only the read-only diagnostic commands shown here. A healthy completed lab will
not reproduce the simulated error.
3. Compare the evidence with the verification note. Do not intentionally damage a key or certificate to
create the failure.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
